summary: Full-energy operator door with pull, engaged deadbolt and bumper rail; the wall bumper stop is a rubber cylinder hanging in the air 0.8 m from the wall where the leaf face ends at 90 deg - there is no wall there to mount it on.

findings.description: Black rubber cylinder at 0.35 m height, 0.8 m out from the wall on the far side, touching nothing (visible as a dot in the closed plan view and in mid-air in the stop close-up). A wall bumper needs a perpendicular wall; here it should be a floor dome stop or nothing.
findings.where: closed / top; closed / back-iso; open / close-up (stop / hold-open)

triage.note: geometry/hinged.py build_swing_single 'wall bumper stop geometry': the bumper is placed at the leaf's face at max opening regardless of whether a wall exists there; use a floor dome (z=0, on the floor) or add the return wall

model: claude-fable-5-1 (Claude Code agent, sheets viewed directly)
